ir_shape: Product(L, L, weight) -- a squared linear form
scope: one per node of the spec's 112-edge generated set (64 nodes with at least one neighbour)
reason: a neighbourhood COUNT's own intent is 'as close to target as possible', which is symmetric by definition -- squaring a linear form over the neighbour indicators keeps this pairwise (Product(L, L, weight)) with no change of meaning. This is a SHAPE, not a domain rule: it is the honest form only where the underlying rule's own intent is symmetric-in-count; a ONE-SIDED threshold ('at least N') is a different rule and distorts under this same shape (audit/expressibility_matrix.md rows #3, #9) -- this template does not detect that case, the caller must not reach for it there
